import nbformat
from nbconvert.preprocessors import ExecutePreprocessor
from nbconvert import HTMLExporter
from pathlib import Path

infile = Path('PerformanveEval.ipynb')
out_html = Path('../results/PerformanveEval.html')

with infile.open() as f:
    nb = nbformat.read(f, as_version=4)

# set kernel metadata if needed already present
# Execute with no timeout and allow errors
ep = ExecutePreprocessor(timeout=None, kernel_name='python3', allow_errors=True)
resources = {'metadata': {'path': '/code'}}
executed_nb, _ = ep.preprocess(nb, resources)

html_exporter = HTMLExporter()
html_exporter.exclude_input_prompt = False
html_exporter.exclude_output_prompt = False
body, _ = html_exporter.from_notebook_node(executed_nb)
out_html.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8')
print(f'Wrote {out_html}')
PY
